summary: First-finish smoke tests for MOLD ASSIST (backend + frontend). Auth, seeded data (10 defects, 4 materials), CRUD for presses/molds, /molding/calculate, /ai/resolve-defect streaming, defect solver UI, molding sheet + PDF, and history all pass. Only minor observation: on wrong-login the frontend does not render an element with .error class (likely uses toast); backend correctly returns 401.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin/admin123 returns JWT (field name is 'token')
GET /api/defects returns 10 seeded defects (BAV, INC, RIS, LNS, BRU, DEF, LSD, STR, PNT, OPA)
GET /api/materials returns 4 seeded materials (PA6, PC, ABS, PP)
POST /api/presses and /api/molds create records (required fields: code,name,tonnage,screw_diameter,max_stroke,max_rpm,qmax for press; code,name,cavities,part_weight,part_thickness for mold)
POST /api/molding/calculate returns full results block (optimal_screw_diameter_mm, cm_mm, qscm_mm, q_comm_mm, n_ideal_rpm, qmax_cm3_s, tmp_s, trr_s, temp_profile[5], melt_temp_avg, mold_temp_avg)
Registries/presses: add-btn opens form with 9 field-* inputs; save-btn persists new press without error
Registries/materials: all 4 seeded material names visible
Defect Solver: defect select (button/combobox) works, description input works
AI streaming (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via emergentintegrations): ai-content populated with non-empty text (>100 chars) starting with 'Cause probabili...'
Molding Sheet: press/mold/material selection + calc-btn -> 18 m-* metric elements rendered
PDF export: pdf-btn click produced no JS pageerror

failed.issue: Wrong-credentials login does not render any element matching .error / [class*=error] selector (toast likely). Backend correctly returns 401.
failed.evidence: Playwright err_text empty; console shows 'Failed to load resource: 401'
console warnings during registries add-btn dialog open

action_items: Optional: add a visible error element (with class 'error' or data-testid='login-error') on failed login for easier automated verification.
Optional: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Radix dialogs to silence a11y warnings.
